item.title: JAMES FORREST: THE BHOY FOR ALL SEASONS
item.description: JAMES FORREST just keeps breaking Celtic records. The evergreen winger is Celtic’s most decorated player with 26 honours, one more than Lisbon Lion Bobby Lennox. Forrest, a youthful 34, surpassed the club icon’s record that had stood for FORTY-FIVE years when he sealed his 13th league medal in the champions’ 5-0 title victory over Dundee United [...]
